subject: OrbitalSoft contracting kickoff — template selection & exhibit responsibilities
messages:
From: Dana Li <contracts@orbitalsoft.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrbitalSoft MSA + Order Form kickoff: templating, signer roles, and timeline

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attaching our current MSA and the filled Order Form for Redwood to review (stubs attached below). A few things we want to align on ahead of legal review so we can avoid multiple redline cycles: 

- Which template should we use as the base (Redwood standard MSA vs. partner-supplement)? If partner-supplement, please share the version/name.
- Who at Redwood will be the contract owner for signature routing (business contact vs legal)? We typically need an exec-level signer + billing contact.
- Hosting/residency: we are subject to a cross-border data policy and want to confirm if Redwood can commit to US-only residency for customer data (Order Form, Exhibit A).
- Security evidence: please confirm whether SOC 2 Type II, encryption-at-rest SLA, and a data processing addendum (DPA) will be requested prior to signature. If yes, we can pre-share your template or accept Redwood's standard DPA.

Attachments (stubs): OrbitalSoft_MSA_v1.docx (MS Word, 220KB), OrbitalSoft_OrderForm.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

Target timeline: we'd like to have an initial Redwood redline by EOD Monday 10/31 so our internal counsel can review and consolidate. Is that feasible?

Thanks —
Dana Li
Head of Legal Operations
OrbitalSoft Inc.
contracts@orbitalsoft.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OrbitalSoft MSA + Order Form kickoff: templating, signer roles, and timeline

Dana —

Appreciate the packet. Quick answers inline: 

- Template: please use the Redwood Standard MSA (we'll provide the latest template). If you have specific carveouts you expect, flag them in the Order Form comments and we'll surface them on first pass.
- Contract owner & routing: business sponsor = Jonas Weber (VP, Partnerships) for signature path; legal owner = Kimberly Park (Contracts Counsel). Final signature typically routed to a Director-level or above depending on T&Cs.
- Residency: we can run US-only residency for customer data for this account. We'll need to capture that as Exhibit B/residency addendum in the Order Form.
- Security evidence: Kimberly will confirm required evidence. Typically we provide SOC 2 Type II summary and a DPA; additional attestations can be requested via our security portal.

Kimberly — looping you in to confirm evidence list and whether you can produce an initial redline by EOD Monday (10/31). Jonas — assigning you as business owner for signatory decisions and billing contact confirmation.

Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 510-555-0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Dana Li <contracts@orbitalsoft.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OrbitalSoft MSA + Order Form kickoff: templating, signer roles, and timeline

Thanks for the details, Camila and Dana. I reviewed the MSA and Order Form stubs and prepared a first-pass redline. High-level notes: 

1) Residency & Data Processing: I added an Exhibit B residency clause (US-only) and proposed a standard Redwood DPA. Please confirm OrbitalSoft's internal DPO contact for data flow mapping.

2) Liability & Caps: Proposed language to align limitation of liability with our standard (commercial cap tied to 12 months' fees). If OrbitalSoft needs higher liability for regulated use-cases, flag that now so we can evaluate insurance proof or carveouts.

3) Termination for Convenience: Retained our standard 30-day notice; proposed a mutual termination headroom for pilot phases — see redline.

4) Hosting SLA: Inserted a hosting addendum reference in Exhibit A to capture residency and support levels; asked for confirmation on expected RTO/RPO in the Order Form.

Attached: Orbit-MSA-redline-20261029.docx (redline, Word). I can do an in-call walkthrough with your counsel if helpful — available Mon 10/2 (note: local holiday schedule, please confirm time zone).

Dana — could you: (a) confirm your DPO contact and (b) provide expected annual contract value / seat counts in the Order Form so we can finalize the cap calculation?

Kimberly Park
Contracts Counsel
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0188
